mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hyponatremia and hypokalemia may lower the seizure threshold and reduce ethosuximide efficacy, while ethosuximide may increase chlorthalidone levels through competition for renal tubular secretion.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (sodium, potassium), seizure control, and ethosuximide levels; consider alternative antihypertensive if significant electrolyte disturbances develop.
